 return `<tr class="${esc(p.who)}"><td class="name"><b>${esc(p.topic)}</b><small>${esc(p.slug)}<br>시작 ${esc(String(p.created||'').slice(0,10))}<br>갱신 ${esc(p.updated)}</small></td><td><div class="phase-track">${stages.map(s=>`<div class="phase ${esc(s.stale?'stale':s.status)}"><span>${esc(labels[s.key]||s.label)}</span><small>${s.stale?'재확인':esc(status[s.status]||s.status)}</small></div>`).join('')}</div></td><td class="stage"><b>${p.complete?'완료':esc(labels[p.current]||cur.label)}</b><small>${p.complete?'6단계 승인':esc(status[cur.status]||cur.status||'대기')}${cur.round?' · R'+cur.round:''}</small></td><td><span class="who ${esc(p.who)}">${esc({you:'내 차례',ai:'Claude 작업 중',done:'완료',err:'오류'}[p.who]||p.who)}</span><div>${esc(p.todo)}</div>${p.lock?`<small class="meta">Claude 세션 사용 중 (${esc(p.lock.owner)}…, ${esc(String(p.lock.since||'').slice(5))}부터)</small>`:''}</td><td class="reps"><b>${reps.length}</b> / 6<small style="display:block">${esc(reps.map(s=>labels[s.key]).join(' · ')||'아직 없음')}</small></td><td class="open"><a href="${encodeURIComponent(p.slug)}/index.html">열기 →</a></td></tr>`;
